title: Vishal:
length: about 1 min 14 s with the end card
headline: A labeled library of Vishal's intro and call-to-action lines that Kiva drops into emails and social posts. Not a story video.
story: Seven short sections in order: intros, the first-loan CTA, the lend CTA, learn more, thank yous, more soon, and “none of this happens without people like you”. A plain label card sits between sections. Every line keeps 1 s of clean room before and after, so Kiva can re-cut it without trimming his voice.

What is left to do: remove the tapping noise Atdhe hears in three places, make “in someone's” the same caption size as the rest, and set every caption in Kiva's CEO-series style with more space between letters.
do: Keep the sections in this order, a label card between them.
Leave 1 s of clean room before and after every line (two takes have less: see the rows).
Remove the tapping noise in all three places Atdhe marked on Frame.io. Check every take on headphones.
Keep “in someone's” the same caption size as the rest of the line.
Captions: Kiva green #2AA967, about 25% smaller, lower third, less blur, more space between letters.
dont: No Nick audio: cut “Awesome”, “Amazing”, “Perfect” and his prompts between takes.
Never the $25 take at 00:44. It starts with “Awesome”.
No music bed and no B-roll story. It is a library file.
No logo, label card or fade at 0:00. Frame 1 is the first intro take.
Never the transcript's “Kodke”. It is Ghotge.

Kiva's CEO-series style: about 25% smaller than the first round, inside the lower third, Kiva green #2AA967, a little less blur behind the letters, a soft shadow, and more space between letters and between words (Brit's kerning note, and Atdhe: the captions still look tight). Lines break at natural phrases. Not #EDF4F1 on #223829. The caption clips on this page are Inter, Kiva green, soft shadow, one line at a time. The page cannot add letter spacing: if you set the captions in Premiere, open the tracking until the letters breathe.
Two files: H.264 MP4 1920×1080 (16:9) and 1080×1920 (9:16). Same cut, same captions, re-framed.
checklist: Frame 1 is the first intro take. No logo, label card or fade at 0:00.
Sections in order, a label card between each: CTA — FIRST LOAN, CTA — LEND, LEARN MORE, THANK YOUS, MORE SOON, NONE OF THIS HAPPENS.
Every take has clean room before and after, and no Nick audio.
No tapping noise anywhere (Atdhe's three Frame.io notes).
Captions read “I'm the CEO of Kiva.” with a period, “Thank you for being a part of this with us.” and “And none of this happens without people like you.”
“in someone's” is the same caption size as the rest of the line.
Captions are Kiva green #2AA967, about 25% smaller, inside the lower third, a little less blur, more space between letters.
His name reads Vishal Ghotge everywhere.
End card reads exactly “Give a little. Change a lot.” plus kiva.org.

decisions.b: The general rule wants hook text on frame 1. The brief says this library file has none and opens on the first intro take. This plan follows the brief. Atdhe confirms.
The brief names it CTA “$25”. Graphics on this page never carry a $ sign, so the card reads “CTA — LEND”. Nick can rename it.
Atdhe's three notes are on the Frame.io comments; their times are not on Monday. Bleron finds them from the Frame.io link.
The end card on this page uses Kiva's white wordmark (the only Kiva logo in endcards/kiva). Nick adds the new green K files there if the end card should carry the K.
The Deadline column is empty. Nick sets it.

client_note: Why this matters: Kiva reuses these clips in emails and posts for months. Clean room around each line and right captions save them re-cutting work.
